title: Clean Up This Kitchen
tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

faults.what: The faucet above the right-hand double sink has been removed along with the clutter, leaving a dark, indistinct remnant near the back rim. This changes a fixed fixture that should have stayed.

judge.summary: The counters are substantially tidier and the original finishes are preserved, but the right-hand sink faucet was mistakenly erased.

must_haves.item: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
must_haves.why: Loose dishes, containers, utensils, and bags have been removed, leaving much clearer work surfaces.

must_haves.item: The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
must_haves.why: The original cabinet doors, handles, and beige tiled backsplash remain visibly consistent with the source.

must_haves.item: The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
must_haves.why: The viewpoint and overall layout match, but the prominent faucet over the right-hand double sink is missing.

must_haves.item: Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.
must_haves.why: Most cleared surfaces look continuous, but the erased right-hand faucet leaves an unnatural dark remnant along the sink's back rim.
